title: Dividing With Unit Fractions

Dividing With Unit Fractions

For a whole number divided by a unit fraction, count how many fraction-size groups fit. For a unit fraction divided by a whole number, split that fraction into equal smaller shares.

Worked example

2 ÷ 1/4 = 8 because two wholes contain eight quarters. In contrast, 1/2 ÷ 3 = 1/6 because half a whole is split into three equal shares.

Watch out

These two division situations are different. Draw the whole and mark equal parts before calculating.
